history.summary: A large 1,733 sqft 3BR freehold in D05 West Coast/Pasir Panjang (The Foliage, TOP 2008) at $2.768M / $1,597 PSF — slightly below the $1,628.50 URA median and on the efficiency frontier. The low PSF is partly a function of the oversized unit, the $2.768M quantum sits near the liquidity ceiling, and there is no walkable MRT.
history.rating_rationale: The Foliage prices below its own URA median ($1,597 vs $1,628.50) and sits on_frontier, with a respectable ~3.96%/yr resale appreciation — but on a thin 9-transaction base. The 1,733 sqft format makes the headline PSF look cheap while pushing the absolute quantum to $2.768M, right at the point the buyer pool thins. No walkable MRT and a large, niche 3BR layout cap liquidity. Freehold West Coast land and fair PSF balance the high quantum and thin data — a fair Neutral, not a value buy.
